VALUES ($1, $2, NULLIF($3,'null'), NULLIF($4,'null')::numeric, NULLIF($5,'null')::numeric, NULLIF($6,'null'), NULLIF($7,'null')::numeric, $8, now())
ON CONFLICT (recipe_id) DO UPDATE
SET name = EXCLUDED.name,
    style_name = EXCLUDED.style_name,
    og = EXCLUDED.og,
    fg = EXCLUDED.fg,
    yeast_name = EXCLUDED.yeast_name,
    fermentation_temp_c = EXCLUDED.fermentation_temp_c,
